---
title: "VEP Annotation"
---

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)
library(rstatix)
library(ggsci)
library(splitstackshape)
library(readxl)

input_dir <- ""
output_dir <- ""
plot_dir <- ""
setwd("")
```

## LOAD DATA
```{r message=FALSE}
pick_files <- read.table(paste0(input_dir, "paths_to_annotated_variants_withpick.txt"))

cols <- c("Uploaded_variation", "Location", "Allele", "Gene", "Feature",
          "Feature_type", "Consequence", "cDNA_position", "CDS_position",
          "Protein_position", "Amino_acids", "Codons", "Existing_variation",
          "IMPACT", "DISTANCE", "STRAND", "FLAGS", "PICK", "VARIANT_CLASS", "SYMBOL",
          "SYMBOL_SOURCE", "HGNC_ID", "BIOTYPE", "CANONICAL", "CCDS", "ENSP",
          "SWISSPROT", "TREMBL", "UNIPARC", "UNIPROT_ISOFORM", "GENE_PHENO",
          "SIFT", "EXON", "INTRON", "DOMAINS", "miRNA", "HGVSc", "HGVSp",
          "HGVS_OFFSET", "AF", "CLIN_SIG", "SOMATIC", "PHENO", "PUBMED",
          "MOTIF_NAME", "MOTIF_POS", "HIGH_INF_POS", "MOTIF_SCORE_CHANGE",
          "TRANSCRIPTION_FACTORS")

annot <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 49, nrow = 0))

for (n in 1:nrow(pick_files)) {
  add <- read.table(pick_files[n,], sep = "\t", header = F, comment.char = "#",
                    col.names = cols, na.strings = c("-"))
  add$file <- paste0(pick_files[n,])
  annot <- rbind(annot, add)
}

rm(add, pick_files, cols, n)
```

## FORMAT
```{r}
# Extract sample names
annot <- annot %>%
  mutate(sample = str_extract(file, "pick_results_Feb24/(.*)_variant_effects", group = 1))

# Add group based on sample name patterns
annot <- annot %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    str_detect(sample, "9A")      ~ "young",
    str_detect(sample, "4A|4B")   ~ "old",
    str_detect(sample, "neg")     ~ "active",
    str_detect(sample, "pos")     ~ "dormant",
    str_detect(sample, "pbs")     ~ "Bak-/- Bax d/d",
    TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
  ))
```

## FILTER
```{r}
# Filter out BND translocations (VEP cannot annotate them)
annot <- annot %>% filter(!str_detect(Uploaded_variation, "BND"))

# Keep only PICK==1 variants
annot <- annot %>% filter(PICK == 1)

saveRDS(annot, paste0(output_dir, Sys.Date(), "_all_variant_annotation_all_colony_groups.rds"))
```

## FILTER VEP OUTPUT COLUMNS
```{r}
# Identify and remove columns with no results (all NA)
rm_cols <- as_tibble(colSums(is.na(annot)))
rm_cols$name <- colnames(annot)
empty_cols <- rm_cols %>% filter(value == nrow(annot))
write_csv(rm_cols, paste0(output_dir, "no_results_columns_VEP_PICK.csv"))

annot <- annot %>%
  select(-c(HGNC_ID, UNIPROT_ISOFORM, AF, CLIN_SIG, SOMATIC, PHENO, PUBMED,
            MOTIF_NAME, MOTIF_POS, HIGH_INF_POS, MOTIF_SCORE_CHANGE, TRANSCRIPTION_FACTORS))

saveRDS(annot, paste0(output_dir, Sys.Date(), "_all_variant_annotation_all_colony_groups.rds"))
```

## PLOT - Young vs Old
```{r}
# Unnest comma-separated consequences
sub <- annot %>%
  mutate(Consequence = strsplit(as.character(Consequence), ",")) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(Consequence))

# Color palettes
color.vec_conseq <- c(
  "intron_variant"                     = "coral2",
  "upstream_gene_variant"              = "darkslategrey",
  "splice_region_variant"              = "lightgoldenrod1",
  "5_prime_UTR_variant"                = "darkolivegreen2",
  "missense_variant"                   = "skyblue4",
  "frameshift_variant"                 = "#D6616B",
  "splice_donor_variant"               = "#393B79",
  "intergenic_variant"                 = "violetred4",
  "regulatory_region_variant"          = "tan1",
  "NMD_transcript_variant"             = "cornflowerblue",
  "synonymous_variant"                 = "lightpink4",
  "transcript_ablation"                = "#9dbf00",
  "inframe_insertion"                  = "lightgoldenrod1",
  "inframe_deletion"                   = "#424242",
  "non_coding_transcript_variant"      = "#ecae00",
  "downstream_gene_variant"            = "#ff2600",
  "3_prime_UTR_variant"                = "seagreen4",
  "feature_truncation"                 = "darkslategrey",
  "regulatory_region_ablation"         = "#DCE319FF",
  "coding_sequence_variant"            = "#238dd2",
  "stop_gained"                        = "#9c3568"
)

color.vec_eff <- c(
  "feature_truncation"        = "#56B4E9",
  "frameshift_variant"        = "#1B9E77",
  "inframe_deletion"          = "#A6761D",
  "inframe_insertion"         = "goldenrod1",
  "missense_variant"          = "#D55E00",
  "regulatory_region_ablation"= "violetred4",
  "stop_gained"               = "#E78AC3",
  "transcript_ablation"       = "indianred3"
)

# Variant type vectors
posit_vec <- c("3_prime_UTR_variant", "5_prime_UTR_variant", "coding_sequence_variant",
               "downstream_gene_variant", "intergenic_variant", "intron_variant",
               "non_coding_transcript_exon_variant", "non_coding_transcript_variant",
               "regulatory_region_variant", "splice_donor_variant", "splice_region_variant",
               "upstream_gene_variant")

eff_vec <- c("feature_truncation", "frameshift_variant", "inframe_deletion", "inframe_insertion",
             "missense_variant", "NMD_transcript_variant", "regulatory_region_ablation",
             "regulatory_region_amplification", "stop_gained", "stop_lost",
             "synonymous_variant", "transcript_ablation")

# Filter to Young vs Old
YvsO_data_annot <- sub %>% filter(group %in% c("young", "old"))

posit_df <- YvsO_data_annot %>% filter(Consequence %in% posit_vec)
eff_df   <- YvsO_data_annot %>% filter(Consequence %in% eff_vec)

# Check overlaps between positional and effect consequences
commonalities <- inner_join(posit_df, eff_df, by = "Location")
cat("Unique locations with both positional and effect annotations:", 
    length(unique(commonalities$Location)), "\n")

write_csv(eff_df, paste0(plot_dir, "variants_with_effect_YvsO.csv"))

# Unique variant counts per group
unique_pos_variants_per_group <- posit_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(CountUniqueVariants  = n_distinct(Uploaded_variation),
            CountUniqueLocations = n_distinct(Location))
print(unique_pos_variants_per_group)

write_csv(posit_df, paste0(plot_dir, "position_variants_annotation_VEP_YvsO.csv"))

variant_counts_YvsO <- posit_df %>%
  group_by(Uploaded_variation, Location, Consequence, IMPACT, SYMBOL, CANONICAL, group, sample) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

write_csv(variant_counts_YvsO, paste0(plot_dir, "counts_per_variant_YvsO_VEP.csv"))

# Deduplication: keep single-entry variants + canonical from multi-entry variants
variant_entry_counts <- variant_counts_YvsO %>%
  group_by(Location, sample) %>%
  summarise(EntryCount = n(), .groups = 'drop')

variant_counts_with_info <- variant_counts_YvsO %>%
  left_join(variant_entry_counts, by = c("Location", "sample"))

variants_with_single_entry   <- variant_counts_with_info %>% filter(EntryCount == 1)
variants_with_multiple_entries <- variant_counts_with_info %>% filter(EntryCount > 1)

canonical_from_multiples <- variants_with_multiple_entries %>% filter(CANONICAL == "YES")

write_csv(
  canonical_from_multiples %>%
    group_by(Location, sample) %>% filter(n() > 1),
  paste0(plot_dir, "canonical_multiplets_tobefiltered.csv")
)

FINAL2_position_annotation_df <- rbind(variants_with_single_entry, canonical_from_multiples)

# Merge non_coding_transcript_exon_variant into non_coding_transcript_variant
recode_noncoding <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(Consequence = recode(Consequence,
    "non_coding_transcript_exon_variant" = "non_coding_transcript_variant"))
}

FINAL2_position_annotation_df <- recode_noncoding(FINAL2_position_annotation_df)
posit_df                       <- recode_noncoding(posit_df)

FINAL2_position_annotation_df$group <- factor(FINAL2_position_annotation_df$group, levels = c("young", "old"))
posit_df$group                       <- factor(posit_df$group, levels = c("young", "old"))
eff_df$group                         <- factor(eff_df$group, levels = c("young", "old"))

# Helper to build n-label data
make_n_labels <- function(df) {
  df %>% group_by(group) %>% count() %>%
    mutate(lab = str_c("n=", n), y = 1.1)
}

# Helper to build stacked bar plot
make_stacked_bar <- function(df, fill_var, palette, n_labels) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = group, fill = .data[[fill_var]])) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "count") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Relative Contribution", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    geom_text(data = n_labels, aes(x = group, y = y, label = lab),
              vjust = 0.95, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    labs(fill = "") +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_x_discrete(name = "", labels = c("Young", "Old")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
    theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 0.9, hjust = 0.95),
          axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title   = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.position = "right")
}

# Plot: filtered positional consequences
final_annot_plot_posit_filtered <- make_stacked_bar(
  FINAL2_position_annotation_df, "Consequence", color.vec_conseq,
  make_n_labels(FINAL2_position_annotation_df))

pdf(file = paste0(plot_dir, "final_annot_plot_posit.pdf"), width = 7, height = 4.3)
final_annot_plot_posit_filtered
dev.off()

cont_filtered_posit <- table(FINAL2_position_annotation_df$Consequence,
                             FINAL2_position_annotation_df$group)
print(chisq.test(cont_filtered_posit))

# Plot: unfiltered positional consequences
annot_plot_posit_unfiltered <- make_stacked_bar(
  posit_df, "Consequence", color.vec_conseq, make_n_labels(posit_df))

pdf(file = paste0(plot_dir, "annot_plot_posit_unfiltered_touse_YvsO.pdf"), height = 4.3, width = 7)
annot_plot_posit_unfiltered
dev.off()

print(chisq.test(table(posit_df$Consequence, posit_df$group)))

# Plot: effect consequences
effect_prediction_plot <- make_stacked_bar(
  eff_df, "Consequence", color.vec_eff, make_n_labels(eff_df))

pdf(file = paste0(plot_dir, "effect_variants_annot_plot_YvsO.pdf"), height = 4.3, width = 7)
effect_prediction_plot
dev.off()

print(chisq.test(table(eff_df$Consequence, eff_df$group)))
```

## INDELS - Young vs Old
```{r}
annot_data <- readRDS(paste0(input_dir, "all_variant_annotation_all_colony_groups.rds"))

sub <- annot_data %>%
  mutate(Consequence = strsplit(as.character(Consequence), ",")) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(Consequence))

YvsO_data_annot <- sub %>% filter(group %in% c("young", "old"))
saveRDS(YvsO_data_annot, paste0(input_dir, "YvsO_annot_data_ALL_variants.rds"))

# Filter to indels only
YvsO_indels <- YvsO_data_annot %>%
  filter(!grepl("DEL", Uploaded_variation, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(VARIANT_CLASS != "SNV") %>%
  filter(VARIANT_CLASS != "copy_number_variation") %>%
  mutate(VARIANT_CLASS = ifelse(VARIANT_CLASS == "indel", "complex", VARIANT_CLASS)) %>%
  distinct(Uploaded_variation, Location, Allele, VARIANT_CLASS, sample, group, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("young", "old")))

saveRDS(YvsO_indels, paste0(input_dir, "Annot_data_INDELS_only_UNIQUEentries_YvsO.rds"))

indels.color.vec <- c("deletion" = "coral1", "insertion" = "cornflowerblue", "complex" = "#FDE725")

unique_indel_types <- make_stacked_bar(
  YvsO_indels, "VARIANT_CLASS", indels.color.vec, make_n_labels(YvsO_indels))

pdf(file = paste0(plot_dir, "indel_types_YvsO_unique_17012024.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5)
unique_indel_types
dev.off()

cont_indel_types <- table(YvsO_indels$VARIANT_CLASS, YvsO_indels$group)
print(cont_indel_types)
print(chisq.test(cont_indel_types))
```
